resources.string: Connect your headphones in Bluetooth settings

This phone does not expose the control channel

This phone or headphone firmware does not provide access to noise controls. Battery data may still be available. AirPods require a compatible Bluetooth stack, including Pixel Android 16 QPR3 or Android 17; beta support depends on the build. Use the headphone button or stem to change modes.
Battery data is not available yet.
Add AirMode manually: open Quick Settings → edit tiles → AirMode.
AirMode shows battery levels and changes noise modes on compatible Apple and Sony headphones. Available modes depend on the model. No internet is needed. Your data stays on this phone.
Bluetooth access is needed to see connected headphones, read their battery and send commands. Location access is not needed.
Notifications are only needed to display battery levels after connection or persistently. Battery in the app and the tile work without notification permission.
Allow Bluetooth to see battery levels and control noise modes.
Bluetooth permission was denied. Allow Nearby devices in app settings.
